findings.evidence: Worker step 5: "run `diff ORIGINAL COPY --strict` with one `--allow` per element id the task names or creates (and per arrow it rebinds) ... if `preservation` fails, undo each listed change". The Gotcha at line 85 requires recomputing arrow endpoints when a box moves. Those arrows are neither named nor rebound, so following the move branch makes strict diff flag them, and step 5 then tells the worker to undo the fix and leave detached arrows.
findings.fix: Change step 5 to: "... one `--allow` per element id the task names or creates, per arrow it rebinds, and per arrow whose `points`/`x`/`y` it recomputed because a bound shape moved ...". This lets the move branch pass strict preservation without reverting the endpoint fix.
